a: A bounded context is an explicit boundary where a domain model applies.
Shared language between engineers and domain experts in a context.
Aggregate root is the entry point enforcing invariants for a cluster of entities.
Entities have identity; value objects are defined by attributes.
Domain events record something meaningful that happened in the domain.
Translate external models so they do not corrupt your domain.
Maps relationships between bounded contexts (customer-supplier, conformist).
Domain services hold domain logic that does not naturally fit an entity.
Application services orchestrate use cases and transactions.
Strategic DDD focuses on context boundaries and team alignment.
